label: Missing stated provenance
definition: The explanation says a value, bound, constraint, or necessity lacks a documented need, source, trace, or rationale.
inclusion: Explicit lack of traceability, justification, or stated need.
exclusion: Do not infer that a numerical value is wrong merely because its source is absent.
patterns: not stated (?:or justified )?anywhere in the project context

label: Prescribed design solution
definition: The explanation criticizes imposing an implementation instead of describing the required outcome.
inclusion: An enclosure or other implementation is called a design mandate or solution.
exclusion: Simple absence of provenance is R01; level of abstraction is R03.

label: Abstraction or system boundary
definition: The explanation says a detail belongs at another system level or outside the system of interest.
inclusion: Component-level detail, external linkage, or wrong abstraction level.
exclusion: Operating versus test-context uncertainty is R20.
patterns: (?:level of abstraction|component.level|internal components|outside the system|external.element|different level|system.level requirement)
characteristic of the system of interest

label: Notes mixed into requirement
definition: The explanation criticizes explanatory notes, assumptions, or scoping material appearing with the requirement.
inclusion: Alleged non-requirement sentence, note placement, or assumption mixed into the body.
exclusion: A source note is not automatically a genuine singularity violation; check the PDF.

label: Multiple obligations
definition: The explanation identifies two or more capabilities, characteristics, or constraints within one requirement.
inclusion: Bundled environmental limits, mass plus orientation, or energy plus duration.
exclusion: A capability with an explanatory note alone is R04.

label: Indirect capability phrasing
definition: The explanation criticizes the phrase shall be able to.
inclusion: Directly cites shall be able to as discouraged or prohibited.
exclusion: This is a style claim; the governing style guide is not provided.

label: Negative obligation wording
definition: The explanation criticizes a negative statement such as shall not.
inclusion: Explicit negative phrasing or shall not.
exclusion: No more than/no less than bounds alone are R08.

label: Bound wording criticized
definition: The explanation criticizes no more than, no less than, or not more than phrasing.
inclusion: Explicit upper/lower-bound construction is criticized.
exclusion: A numerical bound lacking a rationale is R01.

label: Dependence on another requirement
definition: The explanation says cross-references or implicit links make the requirement insufficiently self-contained.
inclusion: Cross-reference, dependence on FR1/FR2, missing standalone meaning.
exclusion: Reference frames are R18; referring to evidence in another source is R01.
patterns: instead of stating the capability directly

label: Endpoint versus path accuracy
definition: The explanation distinguishes accuracy at the endpoint from accuracy throughout the path.
inclusion: Explicit end position versus trajectory/entire-motion scope.
exclusion: Measurement datum or test setup alone is R23.

label: Unit or numerical equivalence
definition: The explanation alleges inconsistent metric/imperial or other numerical conversions.
inclusion: 2.5 mm versus 0.1 inch, or another explicit conversion discrepancy.
exclusion: Rounding acceptability is a separate judgment, not established by the code.

label: Environmental bounds undefined
definition: The explanation says qualitative environmental terms or missing tolerances leave the operating envelope unclear.
inclusion: Earth-like, low humidity, temperature/pressure ranges or operating versus survival context.
exclusion: Provenance of stated environmental values alone is R01.

label: Particulate limit or measurement unspecified
definition: The explanation asks for particle size, quantity, concentration, threshold, or measurement conditions.
inclusion: A missing definition or limit for particulates.
exclusion: A missing source for a zero-particulate rule alone is R01.

label: Leakage or containment undefined
definition: The explanation says enclosure or leakage has no defined containment, sealing, or leak-rate criterion.
inclusion: Undefined enclosure/leakage performance or verification conditions.
exclusion: Mandating an enclosure as an implementation is R02.

label: Trajectory or motion scope unspecified
definition: The explanation questions the unspecified path, direction, distance, duration, or scope of the required movement.
inclusion: Notional path treated as ambiguity; PR7 path/distance/duration omitted.
exclusion: Accuracy endpoint/path is R10; gravity interpretation is R20.
patterns: does not state over which motion

label: Payload or interface details omitted
definition: The explanation asks for mass, size, attachment, or interface attributes.
inclusion: Point-mass characteristics or physical interface not defined.
exclusion: Unsupported 3.6 kg provenance alone is R01.

label: Initiating condition omitted
definition: The explanation asks for an electrical signal, trigger, or initiating condition.
inclusion: A missing trigger or control signal for movement.
exclusion: Timed interval boundaries are R22.

label: Coordinates or reference frame omitted
definition: The explanation asks for coordinates, coordinate frame, origin/destination definition, or a reference frame.
inclusion: Spatial references alleged absent or insufficient.
exclusion: Accuracy measurement datum belongs to R23.

label: Energy-budget scope unclear
definition: The explanation questions what all operations covers or the duration/cycle basis of the energy limit.
inclusion: Single traverse/full cycle/standby, one-minute basis, or operational condition.
exclusion: Provenance of 1.5 Wh alone is R01; explicit arithmetic conflict is R24.

label: Gravity orientation or test context unclear
definition: The explanation questions the meaning of perpendicular gravity or whether it describes operation, test, or mounting.
inclusion: Unclear load direction or operating versus ground-test context.
exclusion: An explicit conflict with ISS context is separately R21.

label: Gravity versus mission-context tension
definition: The explanation says normal Earth gravity conflicts with or is not derived from the stated ISS operating context.
inclusion: Explicit Earth-gravity/ISS mismatch or traceability concern.
exclusion: Ground-test interpretation remains a possible alternative; do not automatically declare a physical defect.

label: Timed interval boundaries missing
definition: The explanation says start/stop events for a timing constraint are undefined.
inclusion: No timing start/end/stop or interval boundary definition.
exclusion: The value of the timing limit lacking a source is R01.

label: Accuracy verification conditions missing
definition: The explanation asks for a datum, load, reference point, measurement method, or test condition for accuracy.
inclusion: Missing verification setup or measurement conditions.
exclusion: Pure endpoint-versus-path alternative is R10; allow both when both arguments appear.

label: Duration consistency questioned
definition: The explanation alleges a conflict or lack of reconciliation between one minute and the movement time limits.
inclusion: Explicit tension between energy-budget duration and the other motion timing statements.
exclusion: A general undefined energy scope is R19; arithmetic must be checked.

label: Absolute prohibition unverifiable
definition: The explanation questions the feasibility or verification of an absolute zero-particulate constraint.
inclusion: Explicit impossible/unverifiable absolute/zero condition.
exclusion: Missing a particle threshold alone is R13; zero limit lacking provenance is R01.

label: Implied power constraint
definition: The explanation infers a power level from the stated energy and duration.
inclusion: An explicit calculation or claim of an unstated watt-level constraint.
exclusion: Do not convert an energy budget into an instantaneous power cap without additional assumptions.

label: Assumed component existence
definition: The explanation questions whether lubricated components exist in the system.
inclusion: Explicit allegation that a component is assumed without evidence.
exclusion: Mandating an enclosure for a known component is R02.

label: Claimed environment-value mismatch
definition: The explanation claims stated environmental values do not match an external ISS value.
inclusion: A claimed actual or nominal ISS pressure or value discrepancy.
exclusion: A simple absence of an environmental source is R01. The external fact requires verification.
patterns: do not exactly match the documented ISS
